name: Tailnet
description: Joins the dev container to your tailnet at container start, with Tailscale SSH, a tag and the hostname <prefix>-<folder>-dev. Configures the Tailscale Feature; it does not install Tailscale.

hostnamePrefix.description: Prefix of the hostname. The default is empty, which means the container variable HOSTNAME_PREFIX. If that is also empty, the hostname is <folder>-dev. Letters, digits and hyphens only. Tested with the Tailscale Feature 1.0.8 and Tailscale 1.104.7.

tags.description: Comma-separated Tailscale tags to advertise. The default is tag:devcontainer. The tailnet policy must let the key own them. Tested with the Tailscale Feature 1.0.8 and Tailscale 1.104.7.

authKeyVar.description: Name of the container environment variable that holds the auth key at container start. The default is TS_AUTH_KEY. The key is never stored in the image. Tested with the Tailscale Feature 1.0.8 and Tailscale 1.104.7.

ssh.description: Turn Tailscale SSH on. The default is true. Tested with the Tailscale Feature 1.0.8 and Tailscale 1.104.7.
